tastings.eventName: Aspen Hill Montgomery County ABS MoCo Liquor store
tastings.notes: Imported from March 2026 tasting sheet on 2026-03-29. Sheet label: Aspen Hill. Assigned from column: Natalie.
tastings.highlights: For the last 30 minutes of the tasting, staff directed customers over to the tasting table. One customer said that it was "Better than Tito's", and another that it was "creamy".
tastings.issues: Lots of customers skipped the tasting bar completely, and I noticed that there was more of a wine crowd.

tastings.eventName: Burtonsville Montgomery County MoCo ABS Liquor store
tastings.notes: Imported from March 2026 tasting sheet on 2026-03-29. Sheet label: Burtonsville. Assigned from column: Natalie.
tastings.highlights: Warmer weather increased traffic around 6:30 PM.
tastings.issues: Not really an issue, but a customer commented that $30 would be a more reasonable price.

tastings.notes: Imported from March 2026 tasting sheet on 2026-03-29. Sheet label: Flower Thomas. Assigned from column: Rachel.
tastings.accountFeedback: The store manager was friendly and encouraged customers to try a sample if they hadn’t already, he endorsed the product as very good.
tastings.highlights: People really liked the sweetness of the vodka with the spicy ginger beer. The table was right in front of the entrance so I was able into interact with everyone who came in

tastings.eventName: Clarksburg Montgomery County MoCo ABS Liquor Store
tastings.notes: Imported from March 2026 tasting sheet on 2026-03-29. Sheet label: Clarksburg Mike. Assigned from column: Natalie.
tastings.highlights: This was the most sales I got this year! Could be due to the tasting dates proximity to St. Patrick's Day, but I can't be positive. it was also warmer this week, Monday hit about 80°.
tastings.issues: Nothing of note other than customers generally being in a rush.

tastings.accountFeedback: Tastes great it’s our fav vodka
tastings.highlights: New pricing and great taste and recipes

tastings.eventName: Gaitherburg Square Montgomery County ABS MoCo Store
tastings.notes: Imported from March 2026 tasting sheet on 2026-03-29. Sheet label: Gaithersburg. Assigned from column: Rachel.
tastings.accountFeedback: They said they were happy to have us utilizing their sampling space.
tastings.highlights: I was able to observe Natalie’s interactions with customers which was a great way to get new perspective on the delivery of the brand.
tastings.issues: This was a double booking so I treated it like an additional training. She wrote down all of the details about customer interactions, #of samples, and sales.

tastings.notes: Imported from March 2026 tasting sheet on 2026-03-29. Sheet label: Darnestown. Assigned from column: Natalie.
tastings.highlights: There were lots of interactive customers when they found their way back to the tasting bar; one of the customers who is a registered nurse suggested that for women's history month and Crohn's awareness month, we do a discount towards research.
tastings.issues: The tasting room at this location is in a bad spot (the very back of the store, hidden by shelves), and customers rarely find their way back to us without staff direction.

tastings.eventName: Cabin John Montgomery County MoCo ABS liquor store
tastings.notes: Imported from March 2026 tasting sheet on 2026-03-29. Sheet label: Cabin John. Assigned from column: Rachel.
tastings.accountFeedback: They didn’t say much to me about our product other than he liked the blackberry lemonade. And was glad I was there.
tastings.highlights: The oak barrel & vine locations have very nice tasting areas with counters and appropriate space! There was another taster brand that was serving two kinds of wine which was nice to have someone to interact with.
tastings.issues: It was gloomy rainy weather. I was pretty far in the back of the store so not everyone was coming all the way to the back. It also made it much harder to see who I didn’t get the chance to interact with.

tastings.eventName: White Oak Montgomery County ABS MoCo
tastings.notes: Manager is Crhistian, New store slower traffic likely but new customers to our brand, first introduction. They have a tasting room or set up on barrel at the front door.  Front door location is preferable.  ....I don't see where to add tasters?
tastings.highlights: More sales than I expected, it helped sell the product by going in-depth on how it was founded and explaining its uniqueness.
tastings.issues: Low traffic since the store is new, and I had trouble finding the store since the location is wrong on the website. The correct address for this store is 12259 Prosperity Dr.

tastings.eventName: Silver Spring Montgomery County ABS MoCo
tastings.notes: Plan a little extra time for parking, There is a parking garage or a limited number of parking spots and a back store entrance in the back of store which is a little closer. Let me know if the shelf positioning has moved up and improved from lower shelf.
tastings.accountFeedback: The manager on shift said that Wisher wasn't moving very well here.
tastings.highlights: Customers were chatty, and very willing to listen to background and information about Wisher. This is also a very high traffic location, there was also a concert tonight so I believe that increased customer volume.
tastings.issues: The price seemed to deter a lot of potential buyers.

tastings.notes: PLan a litte extra time. This is inside a mall so bring bag or something easy to carry supplies a little distance. Park in the structure and inside mall follow signs toward Costco. You will see oak barrel and wine there. Directions are tricky (two locations with the same address one is a residential home. In google maps follow the Silver spring choice over the Wheaton address or easiest way is to go to the moco abs location page and click on the address there. https://montgomerycountymd.gov/abs/stores/. Contacts are Chris and Andre I left shelf talker on the frige if they have not placed on shelf ask them for it. use beet sticker to hang. This is a new store and may have slower traffic but you will be offering the first intro to Wisher. Cheers!
tastings.accountFeedback: They have. Tasting room off the the side where I couldn’t see other customers in the store without them being directed by the manager.
tastings.highlights: The manager did direct people into the tasting room.
